name: 葉奕良
objective: 先修課程：3001011 或負責教授同意。力、質量與加速度、質點運動學、質點動力學、功與能、衝量與動量、剛體運動、剛體系的動力學。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1-2: Kinematics of particles
Week 3-4: Kinetics of particles: force, mass, and acceleration
Week 5-6: Kinetics of particles: work and energy
Week 7: Kinetics of particles: impulse and momentum
Week 8: Midterm exam
Week 10-11: Plane kinematics of rigid bodies
Week 12-13: Plane kinetics of rigid bodies: force, mass, and acceleration
Week 14: Plane kinetics of rigid bodies: work and energy
Week 15: Plane kinetics of rigid bodies: impulse and momentum
Week 16: Final exam
Week 17: Steady mass flow and variable mass (彈性教學)
Week 18: Virtual work (彈性教學)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Steady mass flow (chapter 4/6) and variable mass and virtual work (chapter 6/7)
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          繳交作業
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          3%

materials:
Textbook: J. L. Meriam, L. G. Kraige, and J. N. Bolton, "Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics", 9th edition (SI version), John Wiley & Sons, Inc, 2020.

Reference: 陽毅平、朱銘祥、李昌駿、程登湖、李宇修，"動力學－從電影到工程力學"，國立臺灣大學出版中心，2023。
consultation: 請以 email：ylyeh@ntut.edu.tw 聯絡授課教師。實體課程因故取消時，將改以預錄方式進行課程教學，並於 i 學園課程網頁公告課程影片及相關規範。
remarks:
第 17, 18 兩週課程實施彈性教學，內容為課程用書 4/6 (steady mass flow)、4/7 (variable mass)、6/7 (virtual work)。

請同學閱讀上述指定章節內容後，完成相關作業，並於課程第 18 週繳交。
